description: Higher-resolution, memory-tight MOVA profile for one Spark, using the exact official 720p checkpoint and native pipeline. It produces one fail-closed MP4 containing synchronized 24 fps video and 48 kHz audio; use the 360p recipe as the default until this profile completes its physical Spark memory canary. Keeps models on CUDA without CPU offload on GB10 unified memory; smoke fit is estimated, and physical memory and latency qualification remain pending.
title: MOVA 720p native synchronized media single Spark (tight)
